captions.detailed: This 3D model is a replacement side scale for a Swiss Army style pocket knife or keyring organizer. It features a flat, elongated body with rounded ends and smoothly filleted top edges. The scale has three screw holes aligned along its length, two curved semi-circular cutouts on opposite edges to allow fingernail access to tools, and an optional protruding keyring loop on one of the corners.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric Swiss Army Knife-style keyring side replacement in OpenSCAD. The script should allow users to customize the overall length, width, edge curvature, and side thickness, as well as toggle between countersunk screw holes and captive nut holes with an optional integrated keyring loop.
captions.factory: The main body is constructed using a minkowski sum of a hulled pair of cylinders and a sphere to achieve smooth, rounded edges. A difference operation subtracts three screw holes along the length, two spheres for the fingernail cutouts, and a large cube to flatten the bottom face. If the 'renderNutHoles' parameter is active, the script subtracts captive nut shapes and adds an external keyring loop created via a difference of hulled cylinders.
